data.text: We have 100 tons, and catching 50 total leaves 50 to reproduce back to 100 next month. I propose this month’s allocation: 14 tons for me and 9 each for John, Kate, Jack, and Emma. That gives me $14,000 and each of you $9,000 while maintaining the lake’s full stock. I’m asking you to accept less than an equal share this month; I won’t pretend otherwise. John, would you accept 9, or what allocation would you counter with?
